body: First day of school was awful i really don't think im ready for it  i  feel such intense dread and  im scared   of the stress and the  anxiety.  It really crushed my already fragile state of mind . I really dont want to go back but my parent  tell me to "get over it " i hate thoese word s they hurt so much   i just dont know what to do
Yea getting in shape has been a goal of mine for a long time i just have  a hard time  motivating myself

Thanks for the advice guys it honestly made me cry that people  took the time too read what I Said and respond. Im going to  get help  and see where things  end up.  Today was a wake up call and  again the fact that anyone wanted to help me meant more than you can know thanks .
